हालहल, हालहाल, हालाहल, हाला̆हा̆ल, n. A sort of poison, Pañc. i. d. 62 (हालाहल, cf. Böhtl. Ind.

हलि, m.(?),
 1. A furrow.

हलिन्, i. e. हल + इन्, m.
 1. A ploughman.

हलीमक, i. e. हरिमन् + क, [] with ल् for र्, and इ lengthened, n. A sort of jaundice.

हल्य, i. e. हल + य,
 I. adj. Ploughed.
 II. f. या, A multitude of ploughs.

हल्लीष, and हल्लीस हल्लीस, n.
 1. A dance performed by women in a circle.
 2. A minor dramatic entertainment.
हालिक, i. e. हल + इक, adj. Belonging or relating to a plough, as a cultivator, a peasant, Pañc. 225, 22; cattle.
हालिनी, f. A sort of lizard.
हालु, m. A tooth.
